en.answer:
<<16228>> can make an additional attack for each <<7734>>, and for each Synchro monster that specifically lists "<<7734>>" in its text, in your Graveyard.

The following Synchro Monsters specifically list "<<7734>>" in their text:
● <<8475>>
● <<9117>>
● <<16228>>
● <<17253>>
en.question: Which monsters allow <<16228>> to make additional attacks due to its effect?
